text: Faulty phone, no reply, and the company's in another state.
Under the Consumer Protection Act, you can file where you live or work.
File it yourself on e-Jagriti, and appear in person. A lawyer is optional.
The deadline: two years from when the problem arose.
The commission can order a repair, replacement, refund or compensation.
Keep your bill, and every reply, then file with your district commission.
